newsitem.title: USA: US currency objectives remain the same -- Rubin.
newsitem.headline: US currency objectives remain the same -- Rubin.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Thursday said that U.S. currency objectives have not changed.

Asked by reporters following a congressional hearing about whether he was satisfied about movements in currency following the recent Group of Seven ministers' meeting in Berlin, Rubin said "I never had expectations, all I do is pronounce what I think our policy objectives ought to be and our policy objectives remain the same."
Rubin also repeated his assertion that the most likely path for the U.S. economy was solid growth and low inflation.
